AND pc.SUPPLIER_NO = #{supplierNo}
AND a.APPLY_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{acceptApplyNo}, '%')
AND d.PARTS_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partsNo}, '%')

#{no}
